title: Understanding Response Bias
text: Consider what response bias means. It occurs when the responses collected do not accurately reflect the true opinions of the population.

title: Sampling Method
text: Think about how the sampling method might influence the responses. Are there any factors that could lead to biased results?

hintAnswer: The sample may not be representative of the entire student population.
title: Evaluating the Sampling Scheme
text: What is the potential issue with selecting every fifth student in a discussion section?
choices: The sample may not be representative
The sample may not be representative of the entire student population.

hintAnswer: TAs might unintentionally select students they know, leading to biased results.
title: Impact of TA Selection
text: How might the fact that TAs are selecting students affect the results?
choices: TAs have no impact on selection
TAs might select students they know
TAs might unintentionally select students they know, leading to biased results.
